title: CEMIR vs. FISER: a comparative study of reasoning-based and enrichment-based approaches to pragmatic intent recognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.32022v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Intent recognition in human-robot interaction requires agents to resolve ambiguous natural language instructions by inferring the speaker's underlying goals. Research has increasingly focused on two notable paradigms for addressing this task: structured symbolic reasoning and multimodal input enrichment. However, it remains unclear whether enrichment-based methods provide benefit in settings where the ambiguity concerns unstated human intent rather than missing observable scene information. In this paper, we present a comparative and diagnostic study benchmarking FISER - a framework utilizing structured social and embodied reasoning - against CEMIR (Context-Enriched Multimodal Intent Recognition), a method that performs multimodal enrichment by synthesizing narratives and photorealistic images from textual prompts. translated_title: CEMIR 对比 FISER：基于推理与基于增强的语用意图识别方法的比较研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.32022v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：人机交互中的意图识别要求智能体通过推断说话者的潜在目标来解析含糊的自然语言指令。研究日益聚焦于解决该任务的两种重要范式：结构化符号推理与多模态输入增强。然而，当模糊性涉及的是未明说的人类意图而非缺失的可观察场景信息时，基于增强的方法能否带来收益仍不清楚。在本文中，我们提出了一项比较性与诊断性研究，将 FISER——一个利用结构化社会推理与具身推理的框架——与 CEMIR（上下文增强多模态意图识别）进行基准对比，后者通过从文本提示合成叙述与逼真图像来执行多模态增强。我们在四个大语言模型（从 Qwen2.5-Omni-3B 到 GPT-5）上对两种方法进行了评估（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文通过一项跨四个大语言模型的比较性与诊断性研究，对比了基于结构化社会与具身推理的 FISER 和基于多模态叙事与逼真图像增强的 CEMIR，以探究当指令模糊性源于未明说的人类意图而非缺失场景信息时，多模态增强方法是否仍具优势。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a comparative and diagnostic study benchmarking FISER, a reasoning-based framework using structured social and embodied reasoning, against CEMIR, an enrichment-based method synthesizing narratives and photorealistic images, across four LLMs to determine whether multimodal enrichment benefits pragmatic intent recognition when ambiguity concerns unstated human intent rather than missing scene information.
